name: Unwilling Puppet
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 3

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Prop: marotte
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target: one creature
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Will negates; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target falls under the effects of the dominate person spell until the end of your next turn. If you are wielding a marotte, you also move the target 10 ft.
